message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges based on facts.

Facts: Defendant 令狐某某 stole an electric bike (盗窃) with value 2300 yuan, considered large amount. So charge: 盗窃.

Defendant 蒋某某 bought the stolen bike knowing it was stolen, i.e., concealed/hidden criminal proceeds. That's 掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益.

Thus answer should be two charges: 盗窃;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益

Check list: "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益" is present. Yes.

Thus final answer: [罪名]盗窃;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益<eoa>
